capabilities: Upload images pasted into notes via the PicNexus desktop app
Upload images dropped into notes via the PicNexus desktop app
Insert the resulting image link into the active note
Test the connection to the local PicNexus service from plugin settings
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.4.0+ on desktop and a matching local port (default 36799); the README includes a network and privacy disclosure stating the plugin only talks to the local PicNexus service and contains no telemetry.
problem: Pasted and dropped images are stored as local files in the vault, and Obsidian has no built-in way to upload them to an external image hosting service instead.

relations.evidence: uploads images pasted or dropped into Obsidian through the PicNexus desktop app

summary: Image uploader that sends pasted and dropped images through the PicNexus desktop app to a hosting service and inserts the link into the note.
